title: Sordland/Turn06/A_VictoryDayBludishMeeting
description: Scene about the Victory Day Celebrations in Jen. Meeting with different leaders.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge took a left turn and drove th..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge took a left turn and drove through the tiny streets of Jen. The city looked surprisingly clean and well-maintained. There was no sign of the destruction the city suffered during one of the heaviest battles of the Civil War.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you, Serge.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Serge."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Today was a day of special symbolic..."
entries.dialogueText: Today was a day of special symbolic importance for Sordland. Every year, on the 14th of March, proud patriots from all ages gathered to celebrate the end of the Sordish Civil War and Tarquin Soll's victory.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge drove us to the city of Jen,..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge drove us to the city of Jen, the stronghold of Sordish nationalists, for an event organized by the opposition parties to discuss current events. In reality, it was probably a publicity stunt, to show Sordland that the leaders of the Assembly could sit around the same table.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The National Front Party, which gov..."
entries.dialogueText: The National Front Party, which governed the city, undoubtedly had the biggest hand in the organization of the meeting. It was not a coincidence that it fell on "Victory Day".

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Jen had survived one of the worst a..."
entries.dialogueText: Jen had survived one of the worst atrocities of the war, and its Victory Day celebrations were the most jubilant in all of Sordland.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Wow. That was too comfortable of a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wow. That was too comfortable of a drive to have been this fast."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""Mr. President. Mr. Vice President...."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President. Mr. Vice President. We are about to arrive at the Jen Center of Culture. Ms. Morgna had already arrived and she will be waiting for you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr was sitting next to me in the..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr was sitting next to me in the presidential car, skimming through the morning newspaper in silence. Suddenly, Serge rolled down the soundproof window.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr raised his head to look out th..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr raised his head to look out the window. He folded the newspaper and laid it beside him.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""I hope the journey was comfortable..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope the journey was comfortable, sir."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How are you today, Serge?""
entries.dialogueText: "How are you today, Serge?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""See? I wasn't joking. Serge is the..."
entries.dialogueText: "See? I wasn't joking. Serge is the best."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""We have a yard now, and the childr..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have a yard now, and the children have more room to play."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""It makes me proud to be driving th..."
entries.dialogueText: "It makes me proud to be driving the two most important men in Sordland on Victory Day."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""You are embarrassing me, sir. I'm..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are embarrassing me, sir. I'm no special man. It's the Kadilla."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Nah, I should ride with you guys m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nah, I should ride with you guys more often. I can't believe I could actually read on the go."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Although I sure wouldn't mind navi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Although I sure wouldn't mind navigating her dangerous curves one day."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr laughed."
entries.dialogueText: Petr laughed.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""No kidding. My driver Sveta can't..."
entries.dialogueText: "No kidding. My driver Sveta can't hold a candle to him."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Sure was, Serge.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sure was, Serge."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""The three most important men are r..."
entries.dialogueText: "The three most important men are right here in this car, Serge."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Looks like the NFP mayors have rea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Looks like the NFP mayors have really transformed the city. Wasn't this an abandoned warehouse for the longest time?"

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""I believe it used to function as a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe it used to function as a rebel militia base during -- and a little while after -- the Civil War."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Oh, right... The Black Battalion.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, right... The Black Battalion."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The Black Battalion?""
entries.dialogueText: "The Black Battalion?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's been a while since I've heard..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's been a while since I've heard that name."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let's not sour the mood with memor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's not sour the mood with memories of the Civil War."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Sorry. You're right.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry. You're right."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Sorry to bring it up. May it never..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry to bring it up. May it never be spoken again."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""If you remember, they used places..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you remember, they used places like this to organize in the '30s. Luckily for us, Soll handled them long ago."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge stopped the car and went outs..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge stopped the car and went outside to hold our doors.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""Here we are, sirs. I hope you have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Here we are, sirs. I hope you have a great day."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We got out of the car and walked to..."
entries.dialogueText: We got out of the car and walked towards the entrance of the building. Every spot around us was decorated with the flags of Sordland.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We slowed down in front of a colorf..."
entries.dialogueText: We slowed down in front of a colorful plaza overlooking a massive concrete building with a giant sign that read: "Jen Center of Culture."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Well... Maybe not all of them. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well... Maybe not all of them. Their *democratic* counterparts like the Young Sords lived on, after all..."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""...Until you finally banned them.""
entries.dialogueText: "...Until you finally banned them."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge drove us to the city of Jen,..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge drove us to the city of Jen, the Sordish nationalist stronghold, for an event organized to celebrate Victory Day and commemorate the fallen of the Battle of Jen.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "For the National Front Party, which..."
entries.dialogueText: For the National Front Party, which governed the city, the day undoubtedly had great meaning. A lot of their supporters could be seen outside waving party flags.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But today had great symbolic import..."
entries.dialogueText: But today had great symbolic importance for Sordland as a whole too. Every year, on the 14th of March, proud patriots from all ages gathered to celebrate the end of the Sordish Civil War and Tarquin Soll's victory.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Jen had survived one of the worst a..."
entries.dialogueText: Jen had survived one of the worst atrocities of the war, and its Victory Day celebrations were the most jubilant in all of Sordland. Petr and I both decided to attend.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Originally, only Petr and I were sc..."
entries.dialogueText: Originally, only Petr and I were scheduled to attend. But after learning about new developments with the Ishval Ersen case, Nia Morgna was invited as well. Representatives from both the PFJP and NFP had told us they wanted to talk about the case in more detail.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nia departed Holsord first. Petr an..."
entries.dialogueText: Nia departed Holsord first. Petr and I left on our own a little later.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "For the National Front Party, which..."
entries.dialogueText: For the National Front Party, which governed the city, the day undoubtedly had great meaning. Due to the significance of the day and the NFP's lobbying efforts, the celebrations were allowed to take place despite the emergency.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After bidding our farewells, Kesaro..."
entries.dialogueText: After bidding our farewells, Kesaro took us outside the building to join the Victory Day event on the plaza.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Together, we walked up to the cente..."
entries.dialogueText: Together, we walked up to the center of the plaza.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""Mr. President. Mr. Vice President...."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President. Mr. Vice President. We are about to arrive at the Jen Center of Culture. We are slightly earlier than estimated."
